title: Blindsight
author: Peter Watts
summary: In the late twenty-first century, a strange crew is sent to investigate an alien object after thousands of probes lit up the sky. The narrator is a man with a brain rebuilt to observe, not feel. A hard science-fiction novel about consciousness.
readIf: you like hard science fiction that questions what intelligence and awareness are, and are happy to be unsettled.
skipIf: you want warm characters or an easy read, since it is cold, technical and deliberately bleak.

pairings.reason: A classic about people failing to understand something truly alien, with a more melancholy tone.
A short, eerie story of an expedition into an area that does not follow familiar rules.
Another contact story rooted in hard science, with a much wider scope.
